text.p: Creative Programming and Technology Ventures Inc said Thursday it anticipates that its stock will no longer be quoted on the Nasdaq small cap quotation system as of August 13.
The company said it is advising stockholders seeking to transact in CPTV's stock to refer to the NASD's electronic bulletin board system for future quotation and information on the company.

"The company regrets this decision by the Nasdaq listing panel, and disagrees with the decision, based on CPTV's historical and current financial good standing," Gary Vickers, president and chief executive officer said in a statement. "We were granted a temporary extension until August 12, 1997, and we have been informed that this will not be extended. Despite this pending delisting, we continue to evaluate business opportunities."
